dse_runs.notes: Spec: wideband DDS, >=400 MSPS single-lane, max_abs_err <= 2^-12, minimize LUTs. Name suggests infeasible — explore families broadly (iterative, unrolled_k, pipelined_m) to confirm feasibility; pipelined_m with enough stages is the likely throughput path.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **infeasible_dds_400msps** (wideband DDS, ≥400 MSPS single-lane, max error ≤ 2⁻¹², minimize LUTs) was taken down the ladder and finalized as **infeasible with no design selected**. The structured DSE graph (`run_dse`, 100 evals) had its inner architect declare the spec infeasible, so I spent the remaining 300 L1 evaluations on targeted NSGA-II studies of the three other families — pipelined_m (m=2..8), unrolled_k (k=2..8), and iterative — each over the full data-width/guard ranges, and all returned 0 feasible designs. With no feasible front, L2 system simulation and L3 RTL verification had nothing to run, so the spec was closed directly at L1 with a note documenting the exhaustive infeasibility evidence. (Memory is switched off this campaign, so no lesson was stored.)
